trap.label: responsible for / responsibility
trap.wrong: He took the responsibility of the error. She is responsible by the team.
trap.right: He took responsibility for the error. She is responsible for the team.
trap.why: Em português “responsável por” e “responsabilidade pelo erro” usam por/de; o brasileiro traduz por by/of. Em inglês, responsible for e responsibility for.

fix.wrong: I am responsible of the budget.
fix.right: I am responsible for the budget.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “It is my duty to manage the budget.” (responsible)
rewrite.answer: I am responsible for the budget.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “He takes responsibility for it.”
Reescreva: “The manager is responsible by the team.” corrija
rewrite.answer: The manager is responsible for the team.
